evidence.title: GLM-5.3-Flash vs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: Two Chinese AI Labs Independently Converge on the Same Model Architecture

summary: Two separate Chinese research teams released GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, both built on the same flash‑optimized architecture despite being developed independently. The parallel designs underscore a rapid, convergent push toward efficient large‑language‑model scaling in China.
title: Chinese AI Labs Independently Converge on Identical Flash-Optimized Model Architecture for GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.8
